jobs.title: Flexible Part-Time Security Officer – Entry Management
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Entry Management in Fort Worth, TX. This role offers fixed anchor shifts with a six-month commitment and the option to pick up additional shifts at other sites, paying $18.00 per hour.

Responsibilities include customer service, access control, monitoring, incident response, and routine patrols. Minimum two years of security experience, high school diploma, and background check required.
